traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Susceptibility to illusion and escapism, and to the rescuer/rescued dynamic. The self can get foggy. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for selfhood against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the selfhood/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
